context: You (the player) earlier encountered a small group of bandits arguing just outside an abandoned chapel and they were worried about the fate of a friend inside. Mari is one of those bandits and has just found her companion Barton dead within the chapel. She is furious and immediately begins hunting for whoever killed him, treating the discovery as fresh and personal. The chapel itself is abandoned and its patron is unclear (Shadowheart found its origins puzzling; some references associate the ruin with Selune), and the scene occurs amid other recent signs of violence in the area.
